career_ladder.note: HTET qualifies candidates for appointment as Primary Teachers (PRT), Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT), and Post Graduate Teachers (PGT) across Haryana government and private schools. Recruitment is conducted by HSSC (PRT/TGT) and HPSC (PGT), following the Haryana School Education Department Service Rules.

steps.source_label: Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) Information Bulletin & Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules

steps.designation: Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT / Master - Classes 6 to 8)
steps.years: Entry via Level 2 or approx. 5-8 yrs promotion from PRT
steps.source_label: Haryana School Education Department Service Rules

steps.designation: Post Graduate Teacher (PGT / Lecturer - Classes 9 to 12)
steps.years: Entry via Level 3 or approx. 6-10 yrs promotion from TGT
steps.source_label: Haryana State Education (Group B) Service Rules

exam_scheme.note: HTET is conducted by BSEH in three distinct levels corresponding to school teaching tiers. Each paper consists of 150 multiple choice questions (1 mark each, 150 minutes duration) with no negative marking.

stages.stage_name: Level 1 — Primary Teacher (PRT for Classes 1 to 5)
stages.source_label: BSEH HTET Information Bulletin & Scheme of Examination

papers.qualifying_threshold: 60% aggregate (90 marks out of 150) for General; 55% (82 marks) for SC/Differently Abled of Haryana

papers.paper_name: Languages — Hindi (15 MCQs) and English (15 MCQs)
General Studies — Quantitative Aptitude (10), Reasoning Ability (10), and Haryana GK (10)

stages.stage_name: Level 2 — Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT for Classes 6 to 8)
stages.source_label: BSEH HTET Information Bulletin Level 2 Scheme

papers.paper_name: Common Section — CDP (30), Languages Hindi/English (30), and General Studies/Haryana GK (30)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 60% aggregate (90 marks out of 150) for General; 55% (82 marks) for SC of Haryana

papers.paper_name: Subject Specific Elective (60 MCQs: Mathematics & Science, Social Studies, or specific Language)

stages.stage_name: Level 3 — Post Graduate Teacher (PGT for Classes 9 to 12)
stages.source_label: BSEH HTET Information Bulletin Level 3 Scheme

papers.paper_name: Common Section — CDP (30), Languages Hindi/English (30), and General Studies/Haryana GK (30)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 60% aggregate (90 marks out of 150) for General; 55% (82 marks) for SC of Haryana

papers.paper_name: Specialized Post Graduate Subject (60 MCQs in chosen PG discipline: Physics, Chemistry, Maths, English, Commerce, History, etc.)

financial_package.note: Teachers recruited subsequent to qualifying HTET are placed in Functional Pay Levels FPL-6 (₹35,400 for PRT), FPL-7 (₹44,900 for TGT), and FPL-8 (₹47,600 for PGT) under Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Haryana School Education Department Teacher Service Rules & Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated across PRT (base ₹35,400) and PGT (base ₹47,600) entry basic pay with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹20,532 to ₹27,608), House Rent Allowance (8% to 24%), and medical allowance, minus standard NPS deductions.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by City Grade (X/Y/Z: 24%/16%/8%)
Summer and winter vacation leave entitlements as per School Education code
Cashless Medical Scheme under Government of Haryana
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with employer contribution
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and Leave Travel Concession (LTC)

competition_benchmarks.note: HTET certificate is mandatory for all teaching recruitment in Haryana. Passing percentages vary significantly by level, reflecting rigorous academic standards.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 15.25% overall pass rate (34,964 qualified out of 2,29,223 appeared)
years.source_label: BSEH HTET-2023 Result Press Release: 2,52,028 registered, 2,29,223 appeared. Level 1 PRT: 47,700 appeared, 10,488 passed (21.98%); Level 2 TGT: 1,11,212 appeared, 18,293 passed (16.45%); Level 3 PGT: 70,311 appeared, 6,183 passed (8.79%).
